map.液压伺服比例技术 使用指南: Hydraulic Servo Proportional Technology User Guide
map.输入负载质量、行程、响应频率与供油压力，计算伺服缸面积、所需流量、液压固有频率与: Enter moving mass, stroke, response frequency and supply pressure to compute the servo cylinder area, required flow, hydraulic natural frequency and servo valve flow gain, and evaluate the system bandwidth
map.峰值加速度 a_max = ω²·X，ω = 2πf，X = L/2；负载力 F: Peak acceleration a_max = omega^2 * X, omega = 2*pi*f, X = L/2; load force F = m * a_max; cylinder area A = F / [(2/3)*ps]; bore D = sqrt(4A/pi); maximum velocity v = omega * X; required flow Q = A*v*60000; hydraulic natural frequency omega_h = sqrt(4*be*A / (L*m)), f_h = omega_h/2pi; valve rated flow Qn = Q*sqrt(7/(ps-dp)); flow gain Kv = Qn / ir
map.伺服液压系统设计：由负载质量、行程与响应频率算峰值加速度（取正弦运动幅值 X=L: Servo hydraulic system design: from moving mass, stroke and response frequency, compute peak acceleration (take the sine-motion amplitude X = L/2) and multiply by the mass to get the load force; take 2/3 of the load pressure as the supply pressure to estimate the required cylinder area and bore. The hydraulic natural frequency is set by the fluid bulk modulus, cylinder area, stroke and moving mass; system bandwidth is about 1/3 of the natural frequency, and the response frequency should stay below bandwidth to stay stable. Servo valve flow gain is the rated flow converted to a 7 MPa pressure drop divided by the rated current.

map.：指令 500 Hz 阶跃、阀频响 ≥100 Hz、缸行程 100 mm → 系: A 500 Hz command step, valve frequency response >=100 Hz and a 100 mm stroke mean system bandwidth is limited by the valve and the load inertia, so they must be matched.
map.：比例阀分辨率 0.5% 对应 100 mm 行程 ±0.5 mm，精密定位需伺: A proportional valve resolution of 0.5% corresponds to +/-0.5mm over a 100mm stroke; precise positioning needs a servo valve.

map.伺服频响高、精度好、价高；比例居中，用于一般闭环。: Servo valves offer higher frequency response, better accuracy and higher cost; proportional valves sit in the middle and are used for ordinary closed loops.
